website_content.title: ICSI CS December 2026 New Exam Centres Notification
website_content.summary: ICSI has announced 7 new ad hoc examination centres across five states for the CS Executive and Professional December 2026 session. Candidates must complete their enrollment by September 25, 2026, to avoid late fees.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ICSI New Exam Centres Update (December 2026 Session)

The **Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)** has expanded its examination network by introducing **7 new exam centres** on an ad hoc basis. This move aims to provide greater convenience to candidates appearing for the CS Executive and Professional programmes.

### 📍 New Exam Centres & Codes
* **Bihar:** Begusarai (Code: 129), Darbhanga (Code: 130)
* **Uttar Pradesh:** Ayodhya (Code: 268), Saharanpur (Code: 270)
* **Uttarakhand:** Haridwar (Code: 269)
* **Maharashtra:** Ratnagiri (Code: 492)
* **Madhya Pradesh:** Rewa (Code: 493)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Enrollment Window:** 26 August 2026 to 25 September 2026 (Without late fee)
* **Late Fee Enrollment Deadline:** 10 October 2026 (Late fee: ₹250 per group)
* **Pre-Examination Test Deadline:** 24 September 2026 (Without late fee)

### 🛠️ How to Select New Centres
1. Log in to the **ICSI Student Portal** using your credentials.
2. Access the enrollment form for the **December 2026 session**.
3. Navigate to the **Exam Centre Preference** section.
4. Select the desired new centre from the updated drop-down list.
5. Complete the form and submit the applicable fees.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* These centres are opened on an **ad hoc basis** and are subject to review in future sessions.
* Candidates who have already enrolled can check the student portal for **centre-change facility** availability.
* This update does not impact the exam syllabus, pattern, or eligibility criteria.

AIIMS Nagpur has released an official notification for the recruitment of **Senior Residents (SR)** under the Government of India Residency Scheme. This is a prestigious opportunity for medical professionals to work in a premier healthcare institute.

### 📌 Vacancy Highlights
* **Total Posts:** 72

* **Trauma & Emergency:** MD (Emergency Medicine/General Medicine/Anaesthesiology/Respiratory Medicine) or MS (General Surgery/Orthopaedics).

* **Registration:** Mandatory registration with NMC/MCI/State Medical Council.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** Level 11, Cell No. 01 (7th CPC)
* **Basic Pay:** Rs. 67,700/- per month
* **Additional:** Usual allowances including Non-Practising Allowance (NPA), where applicable.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 17 September 2026 (by 5:00 PM)

### 🛠️ Selection Process
* **Primary Method:** Interview at AIIMS Nagpur.
* **Note:** If application volume is high, a written test may be conducted for shortlisting.

### 📝 Application Fee
* **General/EWS/OBC:** Rs. 500
* **SC/ST:** Rs. 250
* **PwD:** Exempted

website_content.title: Delhi University (DU) Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES) Admission 2026
website_content.summary: Delhi University invites applications for the Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES) 2026 starting September 2nd. This unique program allows learners of any age to enroll in individual papers without committing to a full degree.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES)**, conducted by the Institute of Life-Long Learning (ILLL) at the University of Delhi, is designed for lifelong learners who wish to enhance their skills through specific academic papers.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** No age bar; open to all.
* **Target Audience:** Students, working professionals, and senior citizens.
* **Restriction:** Candidates currently enrolled in any regular programme at the University of Delhi are **not eligible** to apply.

## Scheme Highlights
* **Course Load:** Applicants can enroll in a maximum of **2 papers or 8 credits** per semester from the same discipline.
* **Certification:** Successful completion (based on eligibility and attendance) earns credits recorded in the **Academic Bank of Credit (ABC)** and a certificate.
* **Fee Structure:** The cost is **₹6,000 per paper**, payable via the DU Miscellaneous Fee payment system.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Deadline:** Please refer to the official portal for closing dates.

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Registration:** Create an account on the official CES portal.
2. **Course Selection:** Enter the programme name, semester, course/paper name, code, and credits.
3. **Documentation:** Upload the required documents and NOC (if applicable).
4. **Verification:** Wait for the concerned department or college to verify the application.
5. **Payment:** Once verified, pay the fee through the Miscellaneous Fee system.
6. **Confirmation:** Submit the fee receipt to the respective office to finalize admission.

website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the provisional answer key for the AIAPGET 2026 exam. Candidates can now download their responses and challenge any answers until September 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIAPGET 2026 Provisional Answer Key Update

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially published the **provisional answer key** for the All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination on August 22, 2026 (or the re-examination on September 1) can now verify their performance.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Answer Key Release Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Last Date to Raise Objections:** September 5, 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 🛠️ How to Download Answer Key
1. Visit the official AIAPGET portal.
2. Click on the **'Answer Key / Challenge(s)'** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Review your recorded responses and download the PDF for future reference.

### 🚩 How to Raise Objections
* Access the objection link via the official login portal.
* Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
* Upload necessary **supporting documents** as evidence.
* Pay the prescribed **objection processing fee** to make the challenge valid.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* Objections are accepted **only online**; no offline requests will be entertained.
* A challenge is only valid upon successful payment of the processing fee.
* Ensure all login credentials are ready before accessing the portal.

RITES Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting for various professional engineering and architecture roles on a regular basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Max Age |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |

| Assistant Manager / Architect (Healthcare Expert) | 1 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Architect / Building Expert) | 7 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Architect / Metro Rail Expert) | 1 | 32 Years |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. DGM (Structural Engineer / Buildings)**
* **Education:** Full Time B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering AND Master's in Structural Engineering.
* **Experience:** Min 11 years post-qualification experience (including 5 years in design of multi-storied buildings).

**2. Assistant Manager Posts**
* **Structural/BIM/Architect:** B.Tech (Civil) or B.Arch as per specific post requirements.
* **Experience:** Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in the respective specialization.

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale (DGM):** ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000
* **Pay Scale (AM):** ₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000
* **Application Fee:** 
    * General/OBC: ₹600 + Taxes
    * EWS/SC/ST/PwD: ₹300 + Taxes

### ⚙️ Selection Process
* **For DGM:** Document Scrutiny $\rightarrow$ Interview (100% weightage).
* **For Assistant Manager:** Written Test (60% weightage) $\rightarrow$ Document Scrutiny $\rightarrow$ Interview (40% weightage).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Start:** 03 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 30 September 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## MPPSC Veterinary Result 2026 Overview

The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore, has officially declared the results for the **Assistant Director / Veterinary Assistant Surgeon / Veterinary Extension Officer Exam 2026**. A roll-number-wise list of provisionally shortlisted candidates for the interview round has been released.

### Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 80
* **Total Shortlisted for Interview:** 255 candidates (Part A: 193, Part B: 62)
* **Exam Date:** 2 August 2026
* **Result Date:** 3 September 2026

### Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** 3 September 2026
* **Document Submission Deadline:** 24 September 2026
* **Late Submission Window (with ₹3,000 fee):** 25 September to 1 October 2026

### Document Submission Process
Shortlisted candidates must follow these steps to ensure their candidature:
1. **Order:** Arrange all documents as per Appendix Form-01.
2. **Attestation:** Self-attest or notarize photocopies as required.
3. **Identification:** Clearly mention your name, roll number, and total page count on the form.
4. **Submission:** Send the physical set to the Secretary, MPPSC, Residency Area, Indore.
5. **Labeling:** The envelope must be clearly marked as *"Sahayak Sanchalak/Pashu Chikitsa Sahayak Shalya, Pashu Chikitsa Vistar Adhikari Pariksha-2026 ke Sakshatkar hetu Abhilekh"*.

### Important Instructions
* The current list is **provisional**; eligibility will be verified during the interview.
* Interview dates will be announced separately.
* Any candidate providing false information may be debarred at any stage of the selection process.

* Ensure the OMR sheet is not folded or damaged.

website_content.title: UPESSC Special TET 2026 Notification for Serving Teachers & CWSN Educators
website_content.summary: UPESSC has released Advertisement 03/2026 for the Special Teacher Eligibility Test (Special TET) 2026. This mandatory exam is for serving Primary/Upper Primary teachers and approximately 2,500 Special Educators (CWSN).
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 UPESSC Special TET 2026 Overview
Following Supreme Court mandates, the Uttar Pradesh Government is conducting a **Special Teacher Eligibility Test (Special TET)**. This is a mandatory requirement for serving teachers to maintain their positions and for Special Educators (CWSN).

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 5 September 2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** 4 October 2026
* **Last Date for Correction:** 8 October 2026
* **Exam Date:** 3 November 2026

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

### 1. Serving Teachers
* **Primary Level (Class 1-5):** Teachers in State Govt, Local Body, or Aided schools.
* **Upper Primary Level (Class 6-8):** Teachers in State Govt, Local Body, or Aided schools.

### 2. Special Educators (CWSN)
* **Primary Level:** Graduation + RCI-recognized D.Ed Special Education + Active CRR Number.
* **Upper Primary Level:** Graduation + RCI-recognized B.Ed Special Education + Active CRR Number.

## 💰 Application Fee
| Category | Primary Level | Upper Primary Level |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| General / OBC / EWS | ₹1,000 | ₹1,000 |
| SC / ST | ₹500 | ₹500 |
| PwD | ₹300 | ₹300 |

## 📝 Exam Pattern
* **Mode:** Offline (OMR based)
* **Total Questions:** 150 MCQs
* **Total Marks:** 150 (1 mark per question)
* **Duration:** 2 Hours 30 Minutes
* **Negative Marking:** None
* **Qualifying Marks:** 60% for General; 55% for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD.

## 📚 Syllabus Highlights
* **Common Subjects:** Child Development & Teaching Method, Hindi, and English/Urdu/Sanskrit.
* **Primary Level:** Includes Mathematics and Environmental Studies.
* **Upper Primary Level:** Includes Mathematics & Science OR Social Studies.

website_content.title: KLEE 2026 Second Phase Provisional Allotment List Released
website_content.summary: CEE Kerala has announced the second phase provisional seat allotment for 3-year and 5-year LLB courses. Eligible candidates can now download their allotment letters via the official candidate portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KLEE 2026 Second Phase Allotment Overview

The **Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala** has officially released the provisional seat allotment list for the second phase of the Kerala Law Entrance Exam (KLEE) 2026. This applies to both **3-Year LLB** and **5-Year Integrated LLB** programs.

## Important Dates
* **Registration Period:** June 10, 2026 – June 17, 2026
* **Exam Date:** June 28, 2026
* **Final Rank List:** July 27/29, 2026
* **First Phase Final Allotment:** August 17, 2026
* **Second Phase Provisional Allotment:** September 2, 2026

## How to Download Allotment Letter
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala website.
2. Navigate to the **Candidate Portal** (Select either 3-Year or 5-Year LLB).
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Click on the **'Second Phase Provisional Allotment'** link.
5. View your allotted college and download the allotment memo for admission.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Reporting:** Candidates must complete admission formalities within the deadline mentioned in the allotment memo to avoid losing their seat.
* **Upgradation:** If you have moved to a higher-preference college in this phase, your previous admission is automatically cancelled. You must obtain a **Transfer Certificate (TC)** from the previous college.
* **Verification:** Candidates under KIRTADS verification are considered provisionally subject to final approval.

website_content.markdown_content:
## EMRS Staff Selection Examination (ESSE) 2026

The **National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS)** has officially declared the Tier-II results for the **Principal post (Phase 1)** on 3 September 2026. This recruitment drive aims to fill **7,267 vacancies** for various Teaching and Non-Teaching roles across Eklavya Model Residential Schools.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Deadline:** 28 October 2025
* **Tier-II Exam Dates:** 22 to 25 March 2026
* **Tier-II Result (Principal):** 3 September 2026

Candidates can access their results via two primary methods:
1. **Direct PDF Download:** Visit the official portal, find the 'EMRS Tier-II Result 2026 (Principal Post)' link, and search for your roll number using Ctrl+F.
2. **Login Portal:** Log in using your Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth to view detailed scores.

### 📋 Next Steps After Qualifying
Shortlisted candidates must prepare for the following stages:
* **Document Verification (DV):** Mandatory for all qualified candidates.
* **Personal Interview:** Specifically for the Principal post.
* **Skill/Practical Test:** Applicable for specific non-teaching roles.

### 📂 Documents Required for Verification
* **Identity Proof:** Aadhaar, PAN, or Voter ID.
* **Educational Proof:** 10th, 12th, Graduation, and PG transcripts.
* **Professional Proof:** B.Ed degree or relevant teaching diplomas.
* **Category Certificate:** Valid caste/category certificates if applicable.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration & Seat Matrix
website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has opened Round 2 registration and released the seat matrix for NEET UG 2026. Eligible candidates can register and fill their choices from September 3 to September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026 - Round 2 Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC), DGHS, has announced the schedule for **Round 2 (AIQ)** for MBBS and BDS courses. This round is critical for candidates seeking admission under the 15% All India Quota.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Choice Filling Begins:** September 3, 2026
* **Last Date to Register/Lock Choices:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility for Round 2
Round 2 is open to the following categories of candidates:
* Candidates who were **not allotted** any seat in Round 1.
* Candidates who wish to **upgrade** their previously allotted Round 1 seat.
* Candidates who **missed registration** during Round 1.

### 📝 How to Register and Fill Choices
1. **Visit Official Portal:** Access the UG Medical Counselling section.
2. **Fresh Registration:** New candidates must register using their NEET roll number.
3. **Login:** Access the dashboard using registration credentials.
4. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and security deposit.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline to avoid system auto-locking.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Upgradation:** Refer to the official bulletin for specific rules regarding seat upgradation.
* **Seat Reversion:** Seats remaining after Round 2 will not be reverted to participating states.
* **Verification:** Candidates are advised to verify the seat matrix PDF for confirmed vacancy figures.

website_content.summary: State Bank of India invites applications for 207 Specialist Cadre Officer (SCO) positions in its Wealth Management vertical. The application window is open from September 4 to September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
State Bank of India (SBI) is looking for experienced professionals for its Wealth Management vertical on a contract basis. These roles are spread across 17 Circles nationwide with a contract duration of 5 years (renewable for another 4 years).

## Vacancy Details
Total Tentative Vacancies: **207**

* **Zonal Head (Retail):** 1
* **Regional Head:** 5
* **Relationship Manager–Team Lead:** 24
* **Investment Specialist:** 9
* **Investment Officer:** 4
* **VP Wealth:** 91
* **AVP Wealth:** 73

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **Zonal/Regional Head & RM/VP/AVP:** Graduate (MBA, CFP/CFA/NISM preferred).
* **Investment Specialist/Officer:** PG Degree/Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, or CA/CFA.

### Experience Required
* **Zonal Head:** 15+ years in Wealth Management/Retail Banking sales.
* **Regional Head:** 12+ years in relationship management.
* **RM-Team Lead:** 8+ years in relationship management.
* **Investment Specialist:** 6+ years as investment advisor/officer.
* **Investment Officer:** 4+ years post-qualification experience.
* **VP Wealth:** 6+ years in sales & marketing with banks/wealth firms.
* **AVP Wealth:** 3+ years in sales & marketing or 4 years as SBI Wealth CRE.

## Compensation & Benefits
* **Salary:** Annual CTC ranges from **₹27.10 Lakhs (Investment Officer)** to **₹97.00 Lakhs (Zonal Head)**.
* **Additional:** Performance Linked Pay (0% to 45% of Fixed Pay) and Annual Increment Band.

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** 04-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25-09-2026

## Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on qualifications and experience.
2. **Interview:** Personal, telephonic, or video interview (100 marks).
3. **CTC Negotiation:** Individual negotiation for shortlisted candidates.

website_content.markdown_content:
## HOS Re-Appear & CTP Exam 2026 Overview

Haryana Open School (HOS), under the **Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH)**, has released the schedule and application details for students appearing for Re-Appear, CTP (Compartment), and Additional examinations for the year 2026.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15 June 2026

* **Last Date (No Late Fee):** 15 July 2026
* **Class 10th Exam Dates:** 1 October 2026 to 13 October 2026
* **Class 12th Exam Dates:** 1 October 2026 to 22 October 2026

| Class | CTP / Additional Fee | Re-Appear Fee | Practical Fee |

| **10th** | ₹1,250 | ₹1,150 | ₹100 |

## APSC Forest Ranger Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has officially released the provisional answer keys for the OMR-based Screening Test conducted for the post of **Forest Ranger** in the Assam Forest Service under the Environment & Forests Department, Assam.

### 📌 Key Exam Details

* **Marks:** 200 marks per subject

* **Answer Key Release Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Deadline for Objections/Claims:** On or before **07 September 2026**

### 🛠️ How to Raise an Objection
If you disagree with the provisional answer key, follow these guidelines:
* **Mode:** Submissions must be made **online only** via the official portal.
* **Requirement:** Every claim must be backed by an **authentic source** (general websites or unspecified documents are not accepted).
* **Restrictions:** Objections sent via email or hard copy will be strictly ignored.

### 📝 Steps to Download Answer Key
1. Visit the official APSC portal.
2. Navigate to the Forest Ranger Screening Test section (Advt. No. 22/2025).
3. Download the subject-wise PDF for **Botany** or **Zoology**.
4. Match your question paper series (A, B, C, or D) with the provided answer key table.

website_content.title: Maharashtra DSE CAP Round 4 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The Maharashtra CET Cell has released the Round 4 seat allotment results for Direct Second Year Engineering (DSE) admissions. Eligible candidates must complete seat acceptance and institute reporting by September 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **State Common Entrance Test Cell (CET Cell), Maharashtra** has announced the results for the **DSE CAP Round 4**. This result is critical for candidates seeking admission into the Direct Second Year Engineering (DSE) programs through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

## Important Dates
* **Result Release Date:** September 4, 2026
* **Online Seat Acceptance Window:** September 5 to September 7, 2026 (up to 3:00 PM)
* **Physical Reporting to Institute:** On or before September 7, 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## How to Check Allotment Status
1. Visit the official Maharashtra DSE counselling portal.
2. Click on the **CAP Round 4 seat allotment result** link.
3. Log in using your **Application ID** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Review the allotted institute and engineering programme.
5. Download and save the allotment result PDF for admission formalities.

## Post-Allotment mandatory Steps
* **Seat Acceptance:** Log in and accept the offered seat online by Sept 7, 3:00 PM.
* **Fee Payment:** Complete the payment of the seat acceptance fee via the candidate login.
* **Institute Reporting:** Report to the allotted college physically by Sept 7, 5:00 PM to confirm your admission.

## Key Instructions
* Use only the official portal to avoid third-party scams.
* Keep your login credentials ready to avoid last-minute technical delays.
* Ensure you report to the institute; online acceptance alone does not complete the admission process.

website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has commenced Round 2 registration for NEET UG 2026. This round covers seats for MBBS, BDS, and B.Sc Nursing across AIQ, AIIMS, JIPMER, and Deemed Universities.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) and DGHS have opened the registration and choice filling window for **NEET UG 2026 Round 2**. This phase is critical for candidates seeking admission into 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats and 100% seats in Deemed/Central Universities, AFMC, ESIC, AIIMS, and JIPMER.

## Available Courses
* **MBBS**
* **BDS**
* **B.Sc Nursing** (under applicable quotas)

## Key Dates to Remember
* **Registration Window:** September 3 to September 8, 2026
* **Choice Filling Window:** September 3 to September 9, 2026
* **Choice Locking:** September 8 to September 9, 2026
* **PwD Medical Assessment Deadline:** September 5, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Reporting at Allotted Institute:** September 12 to September 18, 2026

## Step-by-Step Registration Process
1. Visit the official MCC portal.
2. Navigate to the **UG Medical Counselling** section and select the Round 2 registration link.
3. New candidates select **'New Registration'**; returning candidates log in with existing credentials.
4. Enter NEET UG roll number and personal details.
5. Upload required scanned documents (photograph, signature, and certificates).
6. Complete the payment for the non-refundable registration fee and refundable security deposit.
7. Log in during the choice filling window to arrange and lock college preferences.

## Critical Instructions
* **Payment Source:** Use only your own bank account/card to ensure seamless refunds.
* **Choice Locking:** Once the locking window closes, no further changes can be made to preferences.
* **Document Readiness:** Ensure all certificates are correctly uploaded to avoid allotment cancellation.

website_content.summary: The Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu has announced the choice-filling window for TNEA 2026 Supplementary Counselling starting September 4. Eligible candidates must lock their college and branch preferences for the provisional seat allotment on September 9.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNEA Supplementary Counselling 2026

The **Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu** is conducting the supplementary counselling process for engineering admissions 2026. Candidates listed in the supplementary rank list can now proceed with their college preferences.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Certificate Upload:** August 17 - August 31, 2026
* **Supplementary Rank List Release:** September 3, 2026
* **Choice Filling Start Date:** September 4, 2026
* **Provisional Allotment Release:** September 9, 2026

### 🛠️ Allotment Process
* **Registration:** Online registration and document upload of scanned certificates.
* **Rank Generation:** DoTE releases rank lists based on merit and category.
* **Choice Filling:** Candidates log in to arrange preferred colleges and branches in order of priority.
* **Tentative Allotment:** System matches candidates based on rank, category, and choices.
* **Confirmation:** Candidates must confirm their acceptance (e.g., accept and join or accept and upward movement).
* **Provisional Allotment:** Final order released on September 9, 2026.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Maximize Choices:** Enter as many college and branch options as possible to increase the likelihood of allotment.
* **Priority Order:** Arrange choices strictly according to genuine preference (highest priority first).
* **Mandatory Confirmation:** Failure to confirm the tentative allotment within the deadline will result in automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Verification:** Regularly monitor registered email and mobile numbers for official notifications.

website_content.title: JNVST Class 9 & 11 Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST) 2027-28
website_content.summary: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) invites online applications for lateral entry admission to Class 9 and Class 11 for the 2027-28 academic session. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)**, under the Ministry of Education, has announced the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST) 2027. This is a prime opportunity for students to secure admission into premier residential schools.

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** September 2, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** September 30, 2026
* **Correction Window:** October 1 to October 3, 2026
* **LEST 2027 Exam Date:** April 10, 2027

## Eligibility Criteria
* **For Class 9 Admission:** Students currently studying in **Class 8** in a government or government-recognized school.
* **For Class 11 Admission:** Students currently studying in **Class 10** in a government or government-recognized school.
* **District Domicile:** Applicants must be studying in the same district as the JNV they are applying to.

## Application Process
* **Registration:** Visit the official NVS portal and register for the respective class.
* **Details:** Fill in basic personal, academic, and communication details.
* **Documents:** Upload photograph, candidate signature, parent signature, and category/UDID certificate (if applicable).
* **Verification:** Preview the application and submit before the deadline.
* **Confirmation:** Download and print the registration slip for future reference.

## Key Instructions
* Ensure the **Date of Birth** matches school records exactly.
* Use an active mobile number and email for admit card and result notifications.
* Refer to the official NVS prospectus for legal eligibility and procedural details.

The Office of the District Programme Officer (Child Development), Balrampur has announced vacancies for **Anganwadi Workers (Karyakatri)** and **Helpers (Sahayika)** on an honorarium basis.

* **Total Posts:** 495

* **Notification Date:** 02 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 23 September 2026

* **Gender:** Women candidates only.

### 🛠️ Selection & Preference Process
Selection for Karyakatri posts follows a strict priority order within the same Gram Sabha/Ward:
1. **BPL Group:** Widows $ightarrow$ Divorced/Deserted $ightarrow$ Other BPL women.

### 📝 Application Guidelines
* **Mode:** Online only via the official portal.
* **Documents Required:** Digitally signed residence, caste, and income certificates. Widow/Divorced candidates must upload relevant legal death certificates or court orders.
* **Restriction:** Two women from the same family cannot be appointed to the same Anganwadi centre.

website_content.title: AP PGCET 2026 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Commissionerate of Higher Education, AP, has opened registration for AP PGCET 2026 counselling for admission into 150+ PG programmes. Eligible candidates must register via the CAP portal by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP PGCET 2026-27 Counselling Overview

The Commissionerate of Higher Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh (APSCHE), has officially opened the counselling process for candidates who qualified in the **AP PGCET 2026** exam. This process facilitates admission into postgraduate programmes across various state universities.

## Key Highlights
* **Participating Institutions:** 17 state universities, their constituent/affiliated colleges, and eligible private universities.
* **Courses Available:** Over **150+ postgraduate (PG) programmes**.
* **Seat Allotment:** Based on PGCET rank, reservation category, local area status, and candidate web options.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** September 1, 2026
* **Registration Start Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Registration End Date:** September 8, 2026

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Login:** Access the CAP portal using your Hall Ticket Number and Date of Birth.
2. **Verification:** Review personal, academic, and rank details.
3. **Documentation:** Upload scanned certificates if automatic verification is unavailable.
4. **Payment:** Pay the non-refundable processing fee via UPI, Debit/Credit Card, or Net Banking.
5. **Submission:** Submit the form and download the confirmation slip.

## Allotment Workflow
* Online Registration $\rightarrow$ Certificate Verification $\rightarrow$ Web Options Entry $\rightarrow$ Seat Allotment $\rightarrow$ Self-Reporting at College.

website_content.title: GMC Mahabubnagar Contract Faculty Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar is hiring 149 contract faculty members including Professors and Junior Residents. Interested candidates must attend a walk-in interview on September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the Director, GMC Mahabubnagar, has announced recruitment for **149 purely temporary contract positions** across 22 departments. 

**Key Details:**
* **Notification No:** 02/GMC-MBNR/2026
* **Appointment Nature:** Contract basis (up to 31-03-2027)
* **Application Mode:** Walk-in Interview Only

## Vacancy Distribution
| Post Name | Total Vacancies | Monthly Remuneration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Professor** | 8 | ₹1,90,000 |
| **Associate Professor** | 19 | ₹1,50,000 |
| **Assistant Professor** | 62 | ₹1,25,000 |
| **Tutor** | 10 | ₹55,000 |
| **Junior Resident** | 50 | ₹46,000 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Professors/Associate Professors:** MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject with required teaching and research experience as per NMC TEQ Regulations 2025.
* **Assistant Professors:** MD/MS in the concerned subject with 1 year of Senior Residency or equivalent experience.
* **Tutors/Junior Residents:** MBBS or equivalent degree.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Must be registered with the **Telangana State Medical Council**.

## Important Dates & Venue
* **Walk-in Interview Date:** 15-09-2026 (9:00 AM to 3:00 PM)
* **Result Declaration:** 17-09-2026
* **Joining Deadline:** 30-09-2026
* **Venue:** Office of the Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar, Edira Campus, Thirulmalla Hills, Mahabubnagar District.

## Required Documents
* Filled application form (from official website)
* Aadhar, PAN, and Date of Birth proof
* Degree certificates and marks memos (MBBS/MD/MS/DNB)
* Telangana Medical Council Registration
* Experience & Senior Residency certificates
* BCBR and MET Certificates (for faculty)

website_content.title: UPSSSC Computer Operator & Assistant Computer Operator Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSSSC invites applications for Computer Operator Grade-A and Assistant Computer Operator posts at the Advocate General's Office, Allahabad High Court. Eligible PET-2025 candidates must apply by September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
UPSSSC has released Advertisement No. 20-Pariksha/2026 for technical positions within the Office of the Advocate General, Allahabad High Court. These are temporary positions selected via a Main Examination based on PET-2025 merit.

## Vacancy Details
* **Computer Operator Grade-A:** 11 Posts (Level-4)
* **Assistant Computer Operator:** 01 Post (Level-2)
* **Total Vacancies:** 12

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Mandatory:** Must have appeared in **PET-2025** and possess a valid score card.
* **Education (Both Posts):** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university AND a Diploma in Computer Science or NIELIT 'O' Level certificate.
* **Experience:** 
    * Grade-A: 3 years of experience in computer applications.
    * Assistant: 2 years of experience in computer applications.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 40 years (as of July 1, 2026). Age relaxation applies as per government norms.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 28 September 2026
* **Correction Window Closes:** 05 October 2026

## Salary Structure
* **Computer Operator Grade-A:** ₹25,500 – ₹81,100 (Grade Pay ₹2,400)
* **Assistant Computer Operator:** ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 (Grade Pay ₹1,900)

## Selection Process
Shortlisting will be done based on normalized **PET-2025 scores** (15 times the vacancies per category). Shortlisted candidates will appear for a written Main Examination.

website_content.summary: The APPSC has released the provisional selection list for the post of Deputy Educational Officer (DYEO) under Notification No. 14/2023. A total of 38 candidates have been selected across four zones based on CBT and CPT evaluations.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Deputy Educational Officer (DYEO) Selection List 2026

The **Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)**, Vijayawada, has officially announced the selection notification for the direct recruitment of **Deputy Educational Officers (DYEO)** in the A.P. Educational Service.

### 📊 Selection Overview
* **Total Candidates Selected:** 38
* **Zone-I:** 7 Candidates
* **Zone-II:** 12 Candidates
* **Zone-III:** 8 Candidates
* **Zone-IV:** 11 Candidates

### 🛠 Selection Process
The provisional selection is based on a rigorous three-step evaluation:
1. **Computer Based Test (CBT)**
2. **Verification of Original Certificates**
3. **Computer Proficiency Test (CPT)**

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Sessions:** March 26 & 27, 2025
* **Certificate Verification & CPT:** July 20, 2026 & September 02, 2026
* **Final Selection Notification:** September 02, 2026

### ⚠️ Key Conditions for Appointment
* **Character Verification:** Appointment is subject to satisfactory reports on character and antecedents.
* **Physical Fitness:** Candidates must be found physically fit for the post.
* **Document Submission:** Original certificates must be produced as per applicable rules.
* **Legal Clause:** This selection is subject to the outcome of pending court cases (W.P. No. 7098/2025, 24759/2026, and 24742/2026).
* **Verification:** Any false information provided will lead to immediate cancellation of the provisional selection.

website_content.title: Maharashtra B.Ed CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The State CET Cell, Maharashtra, will release the B.Ed CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment results on September 4, 2026. Allotted candidates must report to their respective institutes between September 7 and September 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Maharashtra B.Ed CAP Round 1 Seat Allotment 2026

The **State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra** is scheduled to announce the seat allotment for the first round of the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for B.Ed admissions.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** September 4, 2026 (Expected)
* **Institute Reporting & Confirmation:** September 7 to September 10, 2026 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM)
* **College Data Upload:** September 11, 2026
* **Round 2 Vacant Seat Matrix:** September 11, 2026 (Expected)

### 🔑 How to Check Your Allotment Status
1. Visit the official portal: **bedcap26.mahacet.org**
2. Navigate to the **'Candidate Login'** section.
3. Enter your **Application ID** and **Password**.
4. View your allotted college, subject methodology, and seat category.
5. Download and print the **Allotment Letter** for reporting.

### ⚙️ Understanding 'Freeze' vs 'Betterment'
Candidates must choose one of the following options on the portal:

* **Freeze:** You accept the allotted seat as final. You must pay the acceptance fee and report to the college. You will not participate in further rounds.
* **Betterment (Not Freeze):** Available for those allotted Preference 2 or below. You keep the current seat provisionally while trying for a higher preference in Round 2.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Self-Freeze:** Allotment of Preference 1 triggers an automatic self-freeze.
* **Documentation:** Ensure all original documents are ready for reporting between Sept 7-10.
* **Payment:** Complete the Seat Acceptance Fee payment promptly to secure your seat.

2. Navigate to the **Examinations** tab and select **Admit Cards**.
3. Click the link for **Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026**.
4. Log in using your **Registration ID or Roll Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Submit the captcha and download the admit card.
6. Take a printout on plain white paper.

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Day
* **Printed e-Admit Card:** Carrying two copies is highly recommended.
* **Photo ID Proof:** A valid original ID matching the registration details.
* **Specific Instructions:** Any additional documents mentioned on the admit card.

## Key Exam Day Instructions
* **Stationery:** Use only a **black ballpoint pen** for the OMR answer sheet.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, and calculators are strictly banned.
* **Reporting:** Reach the venue well before the reporting time to avoid issues.
* **Verification:** If there is any discrepancy in your name, photo, or centre, contact UPSC immediately before the exam.

* **Interview Admit Card Release:** September 2, 2026

## Required Documents for Interview
Candidates are advised to carry the following documents to the venue to avoid disqualification:
* **Printed Interview Admit Card** (Mandatory)
* **Original Photo ID Proof** (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License)
* **Educational Certificates** (Matriculation/Higher Secondary originals and photocopies)
* **Valid LMV Driving License**
* **Experience Certificates** (Proof of minimum 2 years driving experience)
* **Category Certificate** (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/ESM), if applicable
* **Recent Passport-size Photographs**

website_content.title: PFRDA Officer Grade A (Assistant Manager) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: PFRDA has announced 30 vacancies for Officer Grade 'A' (Assistant Manager) across four specialized streams. Applications are open from September 3 to September 24, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## PFRDA Officer Grade A Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) is inviting online applications for the post of **Officer Grade 'A' (Assistant Manager)**. This is a prestigious opportunity for professionals to join a regulatory body governing the pension sector in India.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
A total of **30 posts** are available across the following streams:
* **General:** 25 Posts
* **Research:** 2 Posts
* **Actuary:** 2 Posts
* **Official Language (Rajbhasha):** 1 Post

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Age Limit:** Maximum **30 years** as of 31.07.2026 (Relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD).

**Educational Qualifications (Stream-wise):**
* **General:** Master's Degree/PG Diploma OR Bachelor's in Law/Engineering OR ACA/FCA/ACS/FCS/ACMA/FCMA/CFA.
* **Research:** Master's Degree/PG Diploma in Economics, Commerce, Finance, Statistics, Data Science, or AI/ML.
* **Actuary:** Graduation + Passing 7 'Core Principles' subjects of IAI Examination.
* **Official Language:** Master's Degree in Hindi/Hindi Translation or specified combinations.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
Selected candidates will receive a highly competitive package with **gross emoluments of approximately Rs. 2,05,000 per month** at the minimum of the scale. Benefits include Housing Allowance, Medical reimbursement, and various other allowances.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
The recruitment consists of three phases:
1. **Phase I:** Online Screening Exam (English, Quant, Reasoning, GA + Stream specific subject).
2. **Phase II:** Online Exam (Descriptive English + Objective stream-specific paper).
3. **Phase III:** Personal Interview.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 03.09.2026
* **Application End Date:** 24.09.2026
* **Phase I Exam Date:** 15.10.2026
* **Phase II Exam Date:** 20.11.2026

website_content.title: BEL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) Bengaluru is inviting eligible ITI candidates for a one-year Short Term Apprenticeship Training (2026-27). Selection will be conducted via a walk-in written test on September 25th and 26th, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## BEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview
Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Defence, is offering apprenticeship opportunities for ITI candidates at the Bengaluru Complex. This training is conducted under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961.

### 📅 Walk-in Selection Schedule
Candidates must report to the **Centre for Learning and Development, Jalahalli, Bangalore** at **01:30 PM** on the following dates:

* **25 September 2026:** Electronic Mechanic, EP
* **26 September 2026:** DMM, Fitter, COPA, Turner, Welder, Electrician

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Qualification:** Must have passed ITI (Passed on or after 01 January 2022).
* **Note:** Candidates awaiting final results are **not eligible**.
* **Age Limit (as of 01 Sept 2025):** Maximum 21 years.
    * SC/ST: 5 years relaxation
    * OBC: 3 years relaxation
* **Domicile:** Only candidates from Southern Region states are eligible (**Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana**).

### 💰 Monthly Stipend
| Trade Category | Stipend |
| :--- | :--- |
| Fitter, DMM, Electrician, Turner, EP, Electronic Mechanic | **₹11,040** |
| COPA / PASAA and Welder | **₹10,040** |

### 📋 Documents Required (Originals)
* SSLC / 10th Marks Card
* Aadhaar Card
* ITI Original Marks Sheet (NCVT/SCVT)
* SC/ST/OBC Certificate (if applicable)

### 🌟 Additional Benefits
* Subsidized canteen, transport, and accommodation.
* Free OPD medical facility at BEL hospital.
* Group Personal Accident Insurance of **₹5,00,000**.

website_content.title: GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) invites online applications for 31 Trainee Project Executive positions across multiple disciplines. Apply between 04 September and 03 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL), a Government of India Undertaking under the **Ministry of Defence**, is recruiting Trainee Project Executives on a contract basis for a period of 2 years (extendable by 1 year).

## Vacancy Details
| Discipline | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Mechanical | 9 |
| Electrical | 12 |
| Electronics | 5 |
| Naval Architecture | 4 |
| Finance | 1 |
| **Total** | **31** |

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture:** Full-time regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4 Years) from a recognized university.
* **Finance:** Graduation plus any one of: CA (ICAI), Cost Accountant (ICMA), or a 2-year PG Diploma/Degree in Finance.

### Experience
* Minimum **1 year of relevant experience** or one year of Graduate Apprenticeship training (as of 31 July 2026).

## Age Limit (as of 31 July 2026)
* **UR / EWS:** 28 Years
* **OBC:** 31 Years
* **SC / ST:** 33 Years

## Salary Structure (Consolidated Pay)
* **1st Year:** ₹35,000 per month
* **2nd Year:** ₹38,000 per month
* **Extended Tenure:** ₹40,000 per month

## Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** (25% General Aptitude, 75% Subject-related)
2. **Document Verification**
3. **Group Discussion / Interview**

*Final Grading: Written Test (85%) + GD/Interview (15%).*

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 04 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 03 October 2026 (up to 05:00 PM)

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500
* **Exempted:** SC/ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, GSL Graduate Apprentices, and GSL Advance Trainees.

website_content.summary: Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited (TCGL) is hiring for 47 outsourced positions across 29 different posts. Walk-in interviews are scheduled for September 7th and 8th, 2026, in Gandhinagar and Ayodhya.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TCGL Recruitment 2026 Overview
Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited (TCGL), a Government of Gujarat undertaking, is inviting eligible candidates for various technical and administrative positions on a **purely outsourced basis** via Ethos HR Management & Projects Limited.

## 📅 Important Interview Dates & Venues

| Interview Type | Date | Venue |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Technical Posts** | 07-09-2026 | TCGL, Block No. 16/17, 4th Floor, Udhyogbhavan, Sector 11, Gandhinagar |
| **Administrative Posts** | 08-09-2026 | TCGL, Block No. 16/17, 4th Floor, Udhyogbhavan, Sector 11, Gandhinagar |
| **Project Engineer (Ayodhya)** | 07-09-2026 | Tourist Information Bureau, TCGL, Plot No. 4106/4110, Civil Lines, Ayodhya Cantt |

**⚠️ Important:** Registration at the venue is mandatory from **9:30 AM to 11:30 AM** on the day of the interview.

## 💼 Post-Wise Details & Eligibility

### 🛠 Technical Roles (Interview: 07-09-2026)
* **Project Engineer (Ayodhya):** B.E./B.Tech (3yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (6yrs exp). Salary: **₹55,000**
* **Associate Manager:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (7yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (9yrs exp). Salary: **₹35,000**
* **Sr. Associate Engineer:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (5yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (7yrs exp). Salary: **₹30,000**
* **Associate Engineer:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (3yrs exp) OR Diploma Civil (5yrs exp). Salary: **₹25,000**
* **Associate Supervisor:** B.E./B.Tech Civil (1yr exp) OR Diploma Civil (3yrs exp). Salary: **₹18,000**

### 🏢 Administrative & Specialized Roles (Interview: 08-09-2026)
* **Executives/Sr. Executives:** MBA, PG Degree, or Bachelor's in Travel/Tourism/Hotel Management. Salary: **₹25,000 - ₹30,000**
* **Office Assistants:** B.Com/BBA/Any Graduate with relevant experience. Salary: **₹18,000**
* **IT Professionals:** MCA/M.Sc-IT/B.E./B.Tech in ICT. Salary: **₹18,000 - ₹30,000**
* **Legal:** LLB/LLM with experience. Salary: **₹25,000 - ₹30,000**
* **HR/Admin:** English Steno Gr. 1, Consultants, and Office Assistants. Salary: **₹18,000 - ₹25,000**

## 📄 Documents Required
Candidates must bring the following in **original and self-attested photocopies**:
* Updated CV/Resume and recent passport-size photograph.
* Educational and experience certificates.
* Valid Photo ID and Address Proof.
* Marriage certificate/Affidavit (for female candidates with surname changes).

## 🚀 How to Attend
1. Verify eligibility via the official recruitment agency website.
2. Prepare all listed documents.

## Overview
The **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh** has officially released the seat matrix for Round 1 of the UP NEET UG 2026 Counselling. * **Seat Allotment Result:** September 7, 2026

1. **Registration:** Online registration via the official portal.
2. **Verification:** Document upload and payment of security fees.
3. **Selection:** Review the **Seat Matrix** to identify preferred colleges.
4. **Locking:** Fill and lock choices within the stipulated deadline.

6. **Reporting:** Download the allotment letter and report to the assigned college.

* **Verify Data:** Always use the official PDF for seat counts; avoid third-party estimates.
* **Finality of Choice:** Once choices are locked after the deadline, they cannot be edited.
* **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the official portal for any revisions in the schedule.

The State Bank of India (SBI) has officially released the call letters for the **Probationary Officer (PO) Mains Examination 2026**. Candidates who successfully cleared the Preliminary round can now download their admit cards.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Probationary Officer (PO)
* **Total Vacancies:** 1500 (1446 Regular + 54 Backlog)
* **Advertisement No:** CRPD/PO/2026-27/09
* **Mains Exam Date:** 12 September 2026

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Mains Admit Card Release:** 2 September 2026
* **Mains Exam Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Prelims Result Declared:** 28 August 2026

### 📂 Documents to Carry to Exam Centre
To avoid any inconvenience, candidates must carry the following:
* **Printed copy** of the SBI PO Mains Admit Card 2026.
* **Original Photo ID Proof** (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Passport).
* **Recent Passport-size photograph** (same as uploaded in the application).
* Prelims Admit Card (if specifically instructed).

### 🛠️ How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official SBI careers portal.
2. Navigate to **'Current Openings'** and select the PO Recruitment link.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Verify Details:** Check your name, photo, exam centre, and shift timing immediately.
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the centre before the reporting time; late entry is strictly prohibited.
* **Prohibited Items:** Electronic gadgets and calculators are not allowed inside the hall.

## NEET PG 2026 Re-Exam Notification

The **National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)** has announced a re-examination for specific candidates of the NEET PG 2026 exam due to internal power supply failures at two centers in Jaipur on August 30.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Re-Exam Admit Card Release:** September 3, 2026 (Expected)
* **Re-Examination Date:** September 5, 2026
* **Exam Timing:** 3:00 PM to 6:30 PM

### 📍 Who is Eligible for the Re-Exam?
This re-exam is **ONLY** for the 2,445 candidates allotted to the following Jaipur centres:
* **iON Digital Zone iDZ Sitapura 1** (Centre Code: 41682)
* **iON Digital Zone iDZ Sitapura 2** (Centre Code: 41683)

*Note: Candidates from all other nationwide centres are not affected and do not need a new admit card.*

### 🛠️ How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official website: **natboard.edu.in** or **nbe.edu.in**.
2. Click on the link **'NEET PG 2026 Re-Exam Admit Card'**.
3. Log in using your **User ID/Application Number** and **Password**.
4. Download and take a clear printout.

### ⚠️ Candidate Instructions
* **Mandatory Documents:** Carry a printed admit card and a valid original photo ID.
* **Prohibited Items:** No mobile phones or electronic devices allowed inside the centre.
* **Reporting:** Report to the centre well before the scheduled reporting time.

website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is conducting Round 2 of the NEET UG 2026 counselling process to fill remaining seats in medical and dental colleges across India.

**Key Seat Allocations:**
* **15% All India Quota (AIQ)** seats
* **100% seats** of AMU, BHU, JMI, and ESIC institutes

| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Start Date** | September 3, 2026 |
| **Registration Last Date** | September 8, 2026 |
| **Choice Filling & Locking** | September 3 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Seat Allotment Result** | September 11, 2026 |

## 💰 Registration Fees
* **General Category:** Rs. 1,000 (AIQ & Central Universities)
* **SC / ST / OBC / PwD:** Rs. 500 (AIQ & Central Universities)
* **Deemed Universities:** Rs. 5,000 (All Categories)

## 🛠️ Registration Process
1. Visit the official MCC portal.
2. Navigate to the **UG Counselling** tab and select **Round 2 registration**.

* **Mandatory Fresh Registration:** All candidates, including those who registered in Round 1, must register fresh for Round 2.
* **Choice Locking:** Ensure your choices are locked; edits are not permitted after the deadline.
* **Verification:** Regularly check the official portal for any schedule revisions.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has opened registration for NEET UG 2026 Round 2 counselling for AIQ, Deemed, Central Universities, AIIMS, and JIPMER. Eligible candidates can register between September 3 and September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Medical Counselling Committee (MCC)** has released the schedule for **NEET UG 2026 Round 2**. This process covers 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats, as well as 100% of seats in Deemed/Central Universities, AFMC, AIIMS, and JIPMER. Parallel counselling for 85% State Quota seats is also conducted.

## Important Dates
* **Online Registration & Fee Payment:** September 3 to 8, 2026 (Reg up to 3 PM, Fee up to 6 PM on Sept 8)
* **Choice Filling:** September 3 to 9, 2026
* **Choice Locking:** September 8 (4:00 PM) to September 9 (Morning)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Reporting/Joining at Institute:** September 12 to 18, 2026
* **Institute Verification:** September 19, 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
Candidates are eligible for Round 2 if they fall into these categories:
* Qualified NEET UG 2026 and did not participate in Round 1.
* Participated in Round 1 but were not allotted any seat.
* Allotted a seat in Round 1 under the **"Float"** option and seeking an upgrade.
* **Note:** Candidates who chose **"Freeze"** in Round 1 are NOT eligible for Round 2.

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. Visit the official MCC portal.
2. Select the **"UG Medical Counselling"** link.
3. New candidates click "New Registration"; Float candidates log in with existing IDs.
4. Enter personal, educational, and NEET UG result details.
5. Upload scanned photograph and signature.
6. Pay the registration fee and security deposit online.
7. Fill and lock your college/course preferences within the specified window.

## Critical Instructions
* **Freeze vs Float:** Selecting 'Freeze' exits the process; 'Float' allows for Round 2 upgrades while keeping the Round 1 seat as backup.
* **Reporting Deadline:** Failure to report by September 18 may result in forfeiture of the seat and security deposit.
* **Round 3 Limit:** Resignation from AIQ/Deemed seats is not permitted once allotted in Round 3.

website_content.title: NTRUHS UG & PG Results 2026 - Check Your Scorecard
website_content.summary: Dr YSR University of Health Sciences (NTRUHS) has announced the results for undergraduate and postgraduate examinations for the 2026 session. Students can access their subject-wise marks and qualifying status online.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NTRUHS Results 2026 Overview

**Dr YSR University of Health Sciences (NTRUHS)** has officially released the results for various UG and PG examinations for the academic session 2026. Candidates are advised to download their marksheets for future reference.

## Courses Covered
Results have been declared for a wide range of programs, including:
* **Undergraduate (UG):** MBBS, BDS, B.Pharm, B.Sc., B.Com., B.A., and other allied health courses.
* **Postgraduate (PG):** MD, MS, M.Pharm, M.Sc., M.Com., M.A., and other specialized programs.

## How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official university portal.
2. Navigate to the **Results/Examinations** section on the homepage.
3. Select the relevant **Course** and **Examination Session**.
4. Enter your **Hall Ticket Number** and other required credentials.
5. Click **Submit** to view your scorecard.
6. Download and print a copy for your records.

## Marksheet Details
Your online result will contain the following key information:
* Candidate's Full Name
* Hall Ticket / Roll Number
* Course and Year/Semester
* Subject-wise marks obtained
* Overall Result Status (**Pass/Fail**)

## Important Note
In case of any discrepancies in marks or personal details, candidates should immediately contact the **University Examination Branch**.

website_content.title: Karnataka DCET 2026 Round 2 Option Entry
website_content.summary: KEA has opened the Round 2 option entry for lateral entry admission into B.E./B.Tech and Architecture courses for diploma holders. The process commenced on September 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the Round 2 Option Entry for the **Diploma Common Entrance Test (DCET) 2026**. This is a critical step for diploma holders seeking lateral entry admission into the second year (third semester) of B.E./B.Tech engineering degrees and first-year Architecture courses across Karnataka.

## Key Details
* **Purpose:** Lateral Entry Admission
* **Target Audience:** Diploma holders who did not receive an allotment in Round 1 or those wishing to revise their preferences.
* **Option Entry Start Date:** 2nd September 2026

## Important Dates
* **Round 1 Web Option Entry:** August 17, 2026
* **Round 1 Mock/Provisional Allotment:** August 6, 2026
* **Round 2 Option Entry Window:** Started 2nd September 2026

## Step-by-Step Option Entry Process
1. **Visit Official Portals:** Access the KEA official websites.
2. **Login:** Use your DCET 2026 CET number and password.
3. **Course Selection:** Select your preferred courses from the available list.
4. **College Selection:** Choose colleges offering those courses.
5. **Prioritize:** Arrange college-course combinations in order of preference (1, 2, 3...).
6. **Lock & Submit:** Review your choices carefully, submit, and lock them before the deadline.
7. **Documentation:** Download a printout of the submitted form for your records.

## Critical Instructions
* **Official Links Only:** Use only the authorized KEA portals to avoid fraud.
* **Comprehensive List:** Enter as many realistic choices as possible, as options cannot be added after the window closes.
* **Proof of Submission:** Always keep a screenshot or printout of your locked choices.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has commenced Round 2 registration and choice filling for NEET UG 2026. This round includes a dedicated portal and medical assessment schedule for PwD candidates.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MCC NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has officially opened the registration window for **Round 2 of NEET UG 2026 Counselling**. This round is open to candidates seeking admission under various quotas including AIQ, Deemed Universities, Central Universities, AIIMS, JIPMER, ESIC, and AFMC.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Window:** September 3, 2026 – September 8, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 3, 2026 – September 9, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** Around September 11, 2026
* **Reporting/Joining Deadline:** September 18, 2026

### ♿ Special Instructions for PwD Candidates
A dedicated PwD portal has been activated. Candidates applying under the PwD category must adhere to the following medical assessment schedule:
* **Primary Board Reporting:** By 10:30 AM, September 5, 2026
* **Primary Assessment Completion:** By September 6, 2026
* **Appellate Board Reporting:** By September 8, 2026

### 📝 How to Apply
1. **Registration:** Visit the official portal, navigate to 'UG Medical Counselling', and select 'New Registration 2026' or log in with Round 1 credentials.
2. **Details:** Enter NEET UG roll number, registration number, and personal details.
3. **Documentation:** Upload the scanned photograph and signature as per specifications.
4. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and refundable security deposit.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select and lock preferred courses and colleges in order of preference.

### ⚠️ Key Guidelines
* **Fresh Registration:** Candidates who missed Round 1 must complete a fresh registration for Round 2.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates holding a Round 1 seat can opt for an upgrade; physical joining and a willingness declaration are mandatory to retain the seat.
* **PwD Compliance:** Failure to complete medical assessments within the timeline may lead to the disqualification of the PwD category claim.

website_content.title: CGPSC State Service Examination (SSE) 2025 Interview Call Letter 2026
website_content.summary: CGPSC has released the Interview Call Letters and required proformas for the State Service Examination 2025 (eService). Candidates who cleared the Mains stage can now download their admit cards via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC)** has officially released the Interview Call Letters for the **State Service Examination 2025 (eService)**. Candidates who have successfully cleared the Mains stage are now eligible to download their call letters and essential proformas.

## Important Dates
* **Prelims Examination:** 22nd February 2026
* **Mains Examination:** 6th to 9th June 2026
* **Interview Call Letter Release:** 2nd September 2026

## Key Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 239
* **Current Stage:** Interview Phase
* **Download Mode:** Online via registered login credentials

## How to Download Interview Call Letter
1. Visit the official candidate login portal: `online.ecgpsconline.in`.
2. Log in using your registered **Email ID and Password**.
3. Navigate to the link for **"State Service Examination 2025 (eService) Interview Call Letter and Required Proformas."**
4. Download the call letter and the specified proformas in PDF format.
5. Ensure you take at least **two printouts** (one for the interview and one backup).

## Required Documents for Interview
Candidates must carry the following documents to the venue:
* Printed Interview Call Letter
* Duly filled proformas (available on the portal)
* Valid Photo ID Proof
* Original and photocopies of Educational Certificates
* Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
* Domicile Certificate
* Recent passport-size photographs

## Important Instructions
* Call letters are **not sent by post**; they must be downloaded online.
* Report to the venue strictly at the time mentioned on your individual call letter.
* Any errors in personal details should be reported to CGPSC immediately.

website_content.title: Goa Samagra Shiksha (GSS) Teacher (Foundational Stage) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Goa Samagra Shiksha (GSS) is recruiting 78 Teachers for the Foundational Stage on a contract basis. Selection will be based on a walk-in interview scheduled for September 4, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Goa Samagra Shiksha (GSS), under the Directorate of Education, Goa, has announced vacancies for **Teacher (Foundational Stage)**. This recruitment is purely on a contract basis until March 31, 2027.

## Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **78**

**Block-wise Distribution:**
* Bicholim: 12
* Tiswadi, Dharbandora, Ponda: 10 each
* Sattari: 8
* Pernem, Bardez: 6 each
* Mormugao: 5
* Quepem, Canacona: 4 each
* Salcete: 3

**Category-wise Distribution:**
* UR: 46 | OBC: 21 | ST: 9 | SC: 2

## Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualification:**
* HSSC or equivalent certificate.
* Diploma in Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) OR Pre-Primary Teacher Education (PPTT) / D.El.Ed.
* **OR** B.Ed. in Early Childhood Education (NEP-2020).
* **OR** Diploma in Special Education with RCI registration.

**Other Requirements:**
* Minimum one year of teaching or apprenticeship experience.
* Proficiency in **Konkani** language.

## Salary & Tenure
* **Salary:** Fixed consolidated pay of ₹20,000 per month.
* **Tenure:** Contractual appointment up to 31 March 2027.

## Walk-in Interview Schedule
* **Date:** 04 September 2026
* **Reporting Time:** 9:30 AM (Candidates arriving after 11:00 AM will not be entertained)
* **Venue:** Directorate of Education, Alto Porvorim, Goa

## Required Documents
Candidates must bring a full biodata and original/self-attested copies of:
* Birth Certificate
* Educational Qualification Certificates
* Valid Residential Certificate
* Employment Exchange Registration

website_content.title: SSC Junior Engineer (JE) Recruitment 2026 - Notification, Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has invited applications for Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Telecom) and Scientific Assistant (IMD) posts. A total of 1,748 tentative vacancies are available for the 2026 session.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JE 2026 Recruitment Overview
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is conducting the Junior Engineer Examination 2026 to fill positions across various engineering disciplines and scientific roles.

**Key Details:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 1,748 (Tentative)
* **Posts:** JE (Civil), JE (Electrical & Mechanical), JE (Telecom), and Scientific Assistant (IMD)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Examination (CBE) - Objective MCQ
* **Language:** Hindi & English

## Selection Process
The selection is conducted in four primary stages:
1. **Paper-I (CBE):** Qualifying shortlisting stage.
2. **Paper-II (CBE):** Final merit-deciding stage.
3. **Document Verification (DV)**
4. **Medical Examination**

## Exam Pattern
### Paper-I (Qualifying)
* **General Intelligence & Reasoning:** 50 Questions | 50 Marks
* **General Awareness:** 50 Questions | 50 Marks
* **General Engineering (Stream Specific):** 100 Questions | 100 Marks
* **Total:** 200 Marks | **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Negative Marking:** 0.25 per wrong answer

### Paper-II (Merit Stage)
* **General Engineering (Opted Stream):** 100 Questions | 300 Marks
* **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Negative Marking:** 1.00 per wrong answer

## Stream-wise Syllabus
* **Civil & Structural:** Mechanics, Structural Analysis, Concrete/Steel Structures, Surveying, Soil Mechanics, Fluid Mechanics, Irrigation, and Transportation.
* **Electrical:** Network Theorems, Electrical Machines, Generation/Transmission, Power Electronics, and Measurement.
* **Mechanical:** Strength of Materials, Theory of Machines, Thermal Engineering, Fluid Mechanics, and Manufacturing Processes.
* **CS & IT:** Discrete Math, Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Databases, and Computer Networks.
* **Electronics & Telecom:** Diodes, Transistors, Digital Electronics, Antennas, and Wireless Communication.
* **Physics:** Mechanics, Optics, Thermodynamics, Modern Physics, and Semiconductor Devices.
* **Telecommunication:** Signals & Systems, Analog/Digital Communication, and Electromagnetics.

## Important Notes for Candidates
* **On-Screen Tools:** A scientific calculator, IS 456:2000 Code, and Steam Tables will be provided on-screen. Physical copies are prohibited.
* **Difficulty Level:** Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical papers are set at the **Diploma level**, while CS/IT, Electronics, Physics, and Telecom are set at the **Graduation level**.
* **Minimum Qualifying Marks:** UR: 30% | OBC/EWS: 25% | Others: 20%.

## UPSC CMS Result 2026 Overview
The **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** has officially declared the results for the Combined Medical Services Examination (CMSE) 2026. This result is based on the written examination conducted on **August 2, 2026**.

* **Written Exam Date:** August 2, 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 1, 2026
* **Application Window:** March 11, 2026, to March 31, 2026

A total of **1,358 vacancies** were notified for the roles of **Medical Officer** and **Assistant Medical Officer**. These positions are distributed across various prestigious government bodies, including:
* Indian Railways
* Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)
* New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC)

## Next Steps for Qualified Candidates
Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF must complete the following actions **within 15 days** of the result declaration:
1. **Portal Login:** Access the UPSC online portal.

While the official call letter will provide the final checklist, candidates should prepare:
* **MBBS Degree** certificate and mark sheets

website_content.title: GATE 2027 Registration Open - Apply via GOAPS Portal
website_content.summary: IIT Madras has opened the application window for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027. Eligible candidates can apply online through the GOAPS portal until September 27, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GATE 2027 Overview
The **Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027** is being conducted by **IIT Madras** on behalf of the National Coordination Board-GATE, Ministry of Education. This exam is the gateway for M.Tech/Ph.D. admissions and recruitment in various Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** August 27, 2026
* **Regular Registration Deadline:** September 27, 2026
* **Extended Registration (with Late Fee):** October 5, 2026
* **Application Correction Window:** October 14 to October 21, 2026
* **Exam City Allotment:** January 4, 2027
* **Exam Dates:** February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, and 21, 2027

## 💰 Application Fee
| Category | Regular Fee | Extended Fee |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Female / SC / ST / PwD | ₹1,000 per paper | ₹1,500 per paper |
| General / OBC-NCL / EWS | ₹2,000 per paper | ₹2,500 per paper |

## 🛠️ Key Requirements & Instructions
* **DigiLocker Mandatory:** A verified DigiLocker account is compulsory for all Indian national applicants.
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT) with a duration of 3 hours.
* **Facial Recognition:** New facial recognition systems are expected for registration and verification.
* **Paper Selection:** Candidates can opt for one or two approved test paper combinations.

## 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official GOAPS portal.
2. Ensure your **DigiLocker account** is linked and verified.
3. Register to generate an Enrolment ID and Password.
4. Fill in academic and personal details.
5. Select the test paper and preferred exam cities.
6. Upload required documents (Photo/Signature).
7. Pay the fee and submit the application.

website_content.title: MDU Rohtak Mercy Chance / Special Chance Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak has released the admit cards for the Mercy Chance/Special Chance 2026 scheme. Eligible students seeking to clear pending examinations can now download their hall tickets for the September 2026 exams.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU), Rohtak provides the **Mercy Chance/Special Chance** scheme to allow eligible students an additional opportunity to clear their pending examinations and complete their degrees.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15 May 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 July 2026 (Extended)
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 1 September 2026
* **Examination Date:** September 2026 (Exact dates to be confirmed)

## Fee Structure (Course-Wise)
Fees vary based on the chance number (1st, 2nd, or 3rd):

* **General Courses (BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, Diploma):** ₹15,000 to ₹21,000
* **Professional Courses (MBA, LLB, MCA, B.Tech, B.Pharm, B.Ed):** ₹20,000 to ₹27,000
* **Integrated Courses (5/6 Year):** ₹15,000 to ₹27,000

## How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official admit card portal.
2. Enter your **Student ID/No** or **Registration Number**.
3. Submit the details to view your Reappear Admit Card.
4. Verify all details (Name, Roll No, Center) and print the document.

## Crucial Instructions for Candidates
* **Identity Proof:** Candidates must carry a valid **original photo ID** to the exam center.
* **Practical Exams:** Report to the **practical exam center**, not the theory center mentioned by default on the admit card.
* **Payment Issues:** If the fee status shows "Un-Paid" despite payment, email `[email protected]` with payment details.
* **Eligibility Issues:** If status shows "Not Eligible (NE)", visit the Result Branch at Pariksha Sadan, MDU Rohtak, at least 3 days before the exam.

website_content.title: TG TET Hall Ticket 2026 for In-Service Teachers
website_content.summary: The Department of School Education, Government of Telangana, has released the hall tickets for the TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026. Candidates can now download their admit cards for the CBT exam scheduled from September 7 to 11, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026 Overview
The **Telangana Teacher Eligibility Test (TG TET)** for In-Service Teachers is now open for hall ticket downloads. This examination is mandatory for teachers currently working in Government, Local Body, and other specified institutions in Telangana.

## Key Exam Information
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Papers:** 
    * **Paper I:** For Classes I–V
    * **Paper II:** For Classes VI–VIII
* **Purpose:** This qualification is valid **only for continuation in service or promotion**. It cannot be used for direct recruitment.

## Important Dates
* **Hall Ticket Release:** September 2, 2026
* **Examination Window:** September 7, 2026, to September 11, 2026
* **Result Declaration:** Between September 28 and September 30, 2026

## Download Requirements
To access the hall ticket, candidates must provide the following details:
* 12-digit **Aadhaar Number**
* **Journal Number** (from application/fee payment)
* Registered **Mobile Number**
* **Date of Birth** (DD/MM/YYYY)

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Centre
* Printed copy of the **TG TET Hall Ticket 2026**
* Original valid **Photo ID Proof**
* Any other documents mentioned in the official Information Bulletin

website_content.title: SSC JE Recruitment 2026 - Junior Engineer & Scientific Assistant
website_content.summary: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) invites online applications for 1748 tentative vacancies for Junior Engineer and Scientific Assistant posts. The deadline to apply is September 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JE Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced the Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2026. This recruitment covers multiple technical roles across various Central Government organizations, including the India Meteorological Department (IMD).

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 1748 (Tentative)
* **Post Category:** Group 'B', Level-6
* **Application Mode:** Online only

## Posts Offered
* **Junior Engineer (Civil)**
* **Junior Engineer (Electrical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Mechanical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Electrical & Mechanical)**
* **Junior Engineer (Telecom)**
* **Scientific Assistant (IMD)**

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 02.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 22.09.2026 (23:00 hrs)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 23.09.2026
* **Correction Window:** 28.09.2026 to 30.09.2026
* **Paper-I Exam (Tentative):** October/November 2026
* **Paper-II Exam (Tentative):** December 2026

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **JE (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical):** Degree or Diploma in the respective engineering discipline from a recognized institute.
* **JE (Telecom):** Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology (Electrical, Electronics, CS, IT, etc.).
* **Scientific Assistant (IMD):** Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics or relevant Engineering degree.

### Age Limit (as of 01.08.2026)
* **General:** Up to 30 or 32 years (depending on the organization).
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

## Selection Process
1. **Paper-I (CBE):** Qualifying exam covering Reasoning, General Awareness, and Technical subjects.
2. **Paper-II (CBE):** In-depth technical subject examination.
3. **Document Verification:** Verification of original certificates.
4. **Medical/Physical Standards:** Applicable for specific posts (e.g., BRO/GREF).

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS (Male):** ₹100
* **Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM:** Exempted

website_content.title: NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling Registration 2026
website_content.summary: MCC has opened Round 2 counselling for MBBS, BDS, and other UG medical courses. Registration and choice filling began on September 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has officially opened the **NEET UG 2026 Round 2 counselling** registration. This round is critical for candidates who did not secure a seat in Round 1 or those seeking to upgrade their currently allotted seat.

## Courses and Institutions
Admission is available for **MBBS, BDS**, and other participating undergraduate medical courses across:
* 15% All India Quota (AIQ)
* Central Universities
* AIIMS & JIPMER
* ESIC institutes
* Deemed Universities

## Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Starts** | September 3, 2026 |
| **Registration & Fee Payment Closes** | September 8, 2026 |
| **Choice Filling Window** | September 3 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Choice Locking Window** | September 8 to September 9, 2026 |
| **Seat Allotment Result** | September 11, 2026 |

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Portal Access:** Visit the official MCC website.
2. **Registration:** Use 'New Registration' for first-timers or log in with existing Round 1 credentials.
3. **Details:** Enter personal, educational, and category information.
4. **Payment:** Complete the online registration fee payment.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Review and lock your choices before the deadline to ensure they are considered.

## Key Candidate Instructions
* **Strict Deadlines:** MCC generally does not extend registration or choice-locking windows.
* **Verification:** Double-check college names, fee structures, and bond obligations before locking.
* **Security:** Never share your login credentials with third-party agents.
